info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Investment Portfolio Analysis API
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Analysis API provides tools for users to analyze and evaluate their investment portfolios. This API enables businesses to retrieve detailed insights into portfolio performance, risk assessment, and asset allocation. Financial analysts and investment managers can leverage this API to make data-driven decisions and optimize investment strategies. By integrating this API, organizations can enhance their investment management processes and provide valuable insights to their clients.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain a detailed analysis of their investment portfolio, providing insights into performance metrics, risk levels, and asset allocation.

requestBody.description: This request body is designed to provide inputs necessary for performing an investment portfolio analysis. The required parameters for the analysis, such as portfolio details and user preferences, must be included in the payload as structured data in JSON format.

200.description: Successful retrieval of investment portfolio analysis.

GetInvestmentPortfolioAnalysisRequest.title: Investment Portfolio Analysis Request Body
